subject: Codacy medium is TSQLLint set-quoted-identifier on Postgres. Do not add SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER. Do not add .codacy.yml.
body:
OBSERVATION. Codacy medium on #865 is docs/ops/proposals/2026-09-18-clv-same-book.sql:1 'Expected SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON near top of file'.

Engine: TSQLLint (codacy/codacy-tsqllint), rule set-quoted-identifier. Source: SetQuotedIdentifierRule.cs RULE_TEXT is that exact string. It parses with Microsoft.SqlServer.TransactSql.ScriptDom and auto-fix Insert is 'SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;'. That statement does not exist in Postgres.

Why it fires: Codacy maps .sql to language SQL, whose tools are PMD, SQLint, TSQLLint, SQLFluff, Semgrep. Transact-SQL is a separate language on extension .tsql. PostgreSQL is a Codacy language with SQLint only and NO file extensions, so our Neon SQL is never classified as Postgres. SQLFluff on Codacy defaults to dialect postgres; TSQLLint still runs on every .sql. The proposal uses double-quoted identifiers ("picks", "clvSameBookValue"), which is correct Postgres and is exactly what the T-SQL session option is about.

Repo config: none. No .codacy.yml, .codacy.yaml, .tsqllintrc, .sqlfluff, sonar-project.properties. handoff/CI_INTEGRATION_INVENTORY.md already recorded this. 59 tracked .sql files; Codacy PR analysis only reported the one new file in the diff.

INFERENCE. The SQL is right. The linter is the wrong dialect.

What I will not do:
- Add SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON. That is T-SQL. Founder-applied on Neon it is a syntax error or a no-op that lies.
- Add .codacy.yml. Codacy docs: a config file REPLACES UI Ignored files, and 'You can't enable or disable tools' from the file. Tools toggle only on the Code Patterns page. That file is a trap here.
- Rename to .pgsql to dodge the scanner. The proposal is meant to be pasteable into psql.

Nearest thing that can be done:
1. Founder, Codacy UI: Code Patterns, disable TSQLLint. This repo has zero T-SQL. That is the real fix and I cannot do it from git.
2. Optional in-repo: .sqlfluff with dialect = postgres, so SQLFluff (the postgres-capable engine) is pinned if/when config-file mode is on. Does not silence TSQLLint.
3. File-local /* tsqllint-disable set-quoted-identifier */ would silence this one finding without UI. Cost: a T-SQL pragma in a Postgres proposal. I will not add it unless asked.

Not stealing GEM-2. Not touching ranking-candidates further.
